title: GOAP performance
description: Load of goap-bench (make perf) against the graph service: volume written on the change and domain axes, latencies seen by the client and by the service, PostgreSQL.

panels.title: Versions
panels.description: Node versions written: created and modified nodes

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Nodes created

panels.title: Changes
panels.description: Changes committed

panels.title: Links
panels.description: Links written

panels.title: Domain versions
panels.description: Versions of the bench domain published (domain axis)

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Calls that failed (conflicts included)

panels.title: Volume over time
panels.description: Versions, nodes, changes and links written by goap-bench, domain types on the right axis

panels.title: Write rate
panels.description: Versions and changes committed per second (slope over 2 minutes)

panels.title: Write rate against the versions in the graph
panels.description: Versions and changes committed per second (slope over 2 minutes), with the versions already written on the x axis instead of time: how the write rate falls as the graph grows (a trend panel: its x axis is a growing numeric field)

panels.title: Write speed drift per doubling of the volume
panels.description: How the write speed changes when the volume doubles: the versions written per second over the last tenth of the versions written, against the same over the same tenth of half of them, minus 1 (goap-bench bench.write.drift). 0: the speed holds as the data grows; -25%: a quarter slower at twice the volume. A cost that grows with the logarithm of the volume (an index a level deeper) keeps it near 0; one that grows with the volume (a read of a whole table, a list that keeps growing) heads for -50%.

panels.title: Write speed at the volume reached
panels.description: Versions written per second over the last tenth of the versions written (goap-bench bench.write.speed): the speed at the volume reached, not over the last minutes.

panels.title: Writes: latency seen by the client
Latency against the volume written
panels.description: The commit call of a change, with the versions already written on the right axis: how the cost grows with the graph

panels.title: Reads: probes against the growing graph
Answer size (mean)
panels.description: Bytes of the answer of each call: an answer that grows with the graph (a whole commit) shows here

panels.title: Database calls
panels.description: Calls of the service to PostgreSQL (otelpgx), per second

panels.title: Database calls per RPC
panels.description: Read amplification: queries the service makes for each call it answers

panels.title: CPU and memory of the containers (graph, PostgreSQL)
CPU used over the range
panels.description: CPU seconds the container used over the time range (cAdvisor, else the podman exporter: PERF_CONTAINERS)

targets.expr: (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (container_label_com_docker_compose_service) (increase(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_label_com_docker_compose_project="goap-perf", container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~"graph|postgres"}[$__range])), "container", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (name) (increase(podman_container_cpu_seconds_total[$__range]) * on (id) group_left (name) podman_container_info{name=~"goap-perf-(graph|postgres)-1"}), "container", "$1", "name", "goap-perf-(.*)-1")))

panels.title: CPU per 1000 versions, over the range
panels.description: CPU seconds over the range for every 1000 versions the bench wrote in it

targets.expr: (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (container_label_com_docker_compose_service) (increase(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_label_com_docker_compose_project="goap-perf", container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~"graph|postgres"}[$__range])), "container", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (name) (increase(podman_container_cpu_seconds_total[$__range]) * on (id) group_left (name) podman_container_info{name=~"goap-perf-(graph|postgres)-1"}), "container", "$1", "name", "goap-perf-(.*)-1"))) / scalar(increase(goap_bench_versions{service_name="goap-bench"}[$__range]) / 1000)

panels.title: Peak memory
panels.description: The most memory the container held over the range (working set)

targets.expr: (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (container_label_com_docker_compose_service) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container_label_com_docker_compose_project="goap-perf", container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~"graph|postgres"}[$__range]), "container", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (name) (max_over_time(podman_container_mem_usage_bytes[$__range]) * on (id) group_left (name) podman_container_info{name=~"goap-perf-(graph|postgres)-1"}), "container", "$1", "name", "goap-perf-(.*)-1")))

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU the container uses, in cores

targets.expr: (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (container_label_com_docker_compose_service) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_label_com_docker_compose_project="goap-perf", container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~"graph|postgres"}[$__rate_interval])), "container", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (name) (rate(podman_container_cpu_seconds_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (id) group_left (name) podman_container_info{name=~"goap-perf-(graph|postgres)-1"}), "container", "$1", "name", "goap-perf-(.*)-1")))

panels.title: CPU per 1000 versions written
panels.description: CPU seconds the container spends for every 1000 versions written (its CPU rate over the write rate, 2 minutes): flat when a write costs the same whatever the volume

targets.expr: (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (container_label_com_docker_compose_service) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_label_com_docker_compose_project="goap-perf", container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~"graph|postgres"}[2m])), "container", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (name) (rate(podman_container_cpu_seconds_total[2m]) * on (id) group_left (name) podman_container_info{name=~"goap-perf-(graph|postgres)-1"}), "container", "$1", "name", "goap-perf-(.*)-1"))) / scalar(sum(deriv(goap_bench_versions{service_name="goap-bench"}[2m])) / 1000)

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of the container

targets.expr: (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (container_label_com_docker_compose_service) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container_label_com_docker_compose_project="goap-perf", container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~"graph|postgres"}), "container", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.*)"))) or (sum by (container) (label_replace(sum by (name) (podman_container_mem_usage_bytes * on (id) group_left (name) podman_container_info{name=~"goap-perf-(graph|postgres)-1"}), "container", "$1", "name", "goap-perf-(.*)-1")))

panels.title: Rows read by sequential scans
panels.description: Rows PostgreSQL reads by scanning whole tables, per second: a query without an index shows here

panels.title: Rows stored per version written
panels.description: Rows of each table for one version written by the bench (meaningful on a database the bench filled)

panels.title: State reads by source
panels.description: Reads of the state of a commit (ADR 0143), by source: commits (the selection of the versions committed on the branch and the branches it was forked from; the states are not cached, ADR 0156). whole: the whole state, nodes: some nodes (commit, merge).

panels.title: Branches selected on per read
panels.description: Branches of the chain of forks a read of a state selects on (ADR 0143): 1 on main.

panels.title: Versions selected for states
panels.description: Versions selected per second to build states (ADR 0143).

panels.title: State read latency
panels.description: Duration of a read of a state, by scope.

panels.title: Cost by size: what a call handles (goap-bench)
Change calls p95, by links held
panels.description: CommitChange / MergeChange / CommitEdits p95 by the links the nodes of the change hold once written, an order of magnitude per line (bench.op.shaped.duration): a line rising inside its class is the graph slowing down, the higher classes taking more of the traffic is the change getting heavier.

panels.title: Node calls p95, by links held
panels.description: ImpactNodeCheckout / ImpactNodeUpdate p95 by the links the node holds (bench.op.shaped.duration).

panels.title: Change size (mean)
panels.description: Nodes a change writes and links those nodes hold once written, mean over the window (bench.change.edits, bench.change.links).

panels.title: Cache fill
panels.description: Estimated memory each cache holds against its bound (goap_cache_size_bytes / goap_cache_limit_bytes): a cache at 100% evicts to make room

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of the reads of each cache that found their value (goap_cache_reads_total)

panels.title: Cache drops
panels.description: Entries dropped per second, by cache and reason: evicted for room, expired unread for the TTL, too_large never kept (goap_cache_drops_total)
